item.title: Arkansas Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders deploys forestry staff for Oklahoma and Tennessee wildfire, storm response
item.description: Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders has authorized the deployment of six wildland firefighters and four bulldozers to Oklahoma for wildfire suppression, and four personnel to join an Urban Forest Strike Team in Tennessee for urban tree recovery.

item.title: Little Rock Marathon road closures begin Feb. 26
item.description: The Little Rock Marathon will cause road closures in downtown Little Rock beginning Feb. 26, with the entire course expected to be open for traffic by 2 p.m. on Sunday, March 1.

item.title: 'I was scared, I'm not gonna lie' Parent reacts to Benton schools lockdown after nearby stabbing
item.description: Parents in Benton were given quite the scare after 5 schools were put on lockdown following a reported stabbing just a few blocks away from Angie Grant Elementary.

item.title: Arkansas Division of Services for the Blind worker speaks out after federal funding lapse leaves him furloughed again
item.description: Employees at the Division of Services for the Blind are once again out of work as a lapse in federal funding continues to impact operations across Arkansas.

item.title: Little Rock Convention & Visitors Bureau releases 2025 report, highlights tourism growth
item.description: Tourism is going up in Little Rock, according to a report released by the Little Rock Convention & Visitors Bureau.

item.title: Former Arkansas First Ladies fighting to keep PBS on Arkansas TV
item.description: A battle over the future of public television in Arkansas continues on as two former Arkansas first ladies are leading a new group trying to keep PBS on Arkansas airwaves with a deal with Arkansas TV set to expire in late June.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Blog: Critical wildfire danger on Thursday
item.description: Very warm and blustery conditions meet with incoming dry air and our ongoing drought to create an elevated risk of wildfire danger on Thursday, February 19.
